entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-21
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER=false is not an authoritative opt-out for /mt #55392
  • Deprecated package referenced on main #55373
  • GivenDotnetSlnAdd.WhenNestedProjectIsAddedSolutionFoldersAreCreatedBuild: intermittent CS0579 duplicate-attribute build failure on nested .slnx #55358
  • Prevent --output command-line option for multi-targeted projects #13369

Updated

  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.NewFileInNewDirectory: flaky failure — file-watch event order (Add/Update) asserted exactly on macOS arm64 #55357
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.LoggingTests.BinaryLogs: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55258
  • [Known Build Error] DotnetNewTestTemplatesTests.MSTestAndPlaywrightProjectTemplate_...CanBeInstalledAndTestsArePassing fails with UnauthorizedAccessException: Access to the path 'testhost.exe' is denied #55174
  • SourceFileUpdateTests.RenameSourceFile: flaky failure — FileNotFoundException on Foo.cs / missing '> Renamed.cs' output #55137
  • MSBuild child node exits prematurely with ObjectDisposedException in BinaryLogger #55076
  • Flaky: Collection is not empty #54887
  • NavMenu.razor(1,5): error RZ10007: The attribute 'class' is used two or more times for this element. Attributes must be unique (case-insensitive) #54826
  • Test flakiness witt Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantBuildsToBeIncremental tests #54823
  • BackCompatibilityPublish_Hosted_Works fails with file lock on .gz compression temp #53660
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
    10.0.1xx
  • Failure on Helix tests - Tests timing out #40074
    10.0.1xx
  • dotnet-watch tests failing #40006
    10.0.1xx
  • Can't update packages NU1007 : runtime.json could not be found #26551
    Discussion
  • Satellite assemblies not generated for valid neutral culture 'dv' (Divehi/Dhivehi) #54835
    Discussion
  • `dotnetup init` complains the install path already contains a .NET installation #54909
  • Hot Reload of Blazor Server project requires restart reporting attributes in unchanged projects prevent hot reload ENC0033. #55394
  • Reduce PR validation time by conditionally filtering tests based on changed files #55203
  • [Regression in 10.0.101] Running `dotnet test` with `Configuration`/`Platform` environment variables isn't considered #52358
  • Use a shared EvaluationContext for ReleasePropertyProjectLocator pre-evaluation (pack/publish) #55193
    11.0.1xx
  • DoNotPassDisposablesIntoUnawaitedTasksAnalyzer crashes with NRE #53926

PullRequests

Created

  • Normalize SDK build leg naming #55400
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to MSTest/Helix #55399
  • File-based apps: set default properties after SDK imports to match the converted project #55395
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Add ApiCompat conditional test scope #55398
  • Add NetAnalyzers conditional test scope #55397
  • Improve `dotnetup` error handling #55155
  • dotnetup: Improve "everywhere" access mode #55360
  • Add platform-native local container CLI support #55249
    breaking-change, Area-Containers
  • Reorganize compatibility test projects under test/Compatibility #55240
  • Conditional test filtering framework for PR builds #55166
  • Make DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER=false authoritative opt-out #55393
  • Reference Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Authoring.Tasks in template package template #55384
  • Fix CS0579 flake: exclude nested project dirs from parent project default item globs #55382

Updated

  • dotnetup: classify PATH dotnet by managed hive; fix env config doc #55349
  • Add prototype `dotnetup` support policy doc #55390
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55289
  • fix: seperate -> separate typo (#54379) #54402
  • Use AnalysisMode=minimum in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers and fix errors (perf rules) #54125
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Performance improvements in SymbolNamesWithValueOption<T> #54120
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Reduce allocations in EnumsShouldHaveZeroValueAnalyzer #54123
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [Proposal] Use Span-based methods to split strings in analyzers #54121
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well (analyzer fix with performance improvements) #54124
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Re-enable C++/CLI test coverage previously gated on VS 2026 toolset availability #54558
  • Support --nologo in Microsoft.Testing.Platform test mode #55376
  • Run wasm test hosts standalone under `dotnet test` (MTP) #55389
  • Migrate DefineStaticWebAssets to multithreaded task execution #55117
  • Preserve whitespace paths in static web asset tasks #55266
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • Add NETSDK1234 warning for macOS apps with .App or .Service suffix #51441
    stale
